Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.core

Class PrefetchManager

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.core.PrefetchManager
public class PrefetchManager extends Object
PrefetchManager provides intelligent memory prefetching for HFT applications. Optimizes cache behavior through strategic memory access pattern hints and processor-specific prefetch instructions.
